content:
**1) LAYOUT**
*   **Window Container:** Centered modal dialog, approx. [208, 15] to [778, 835]. Dimensions: 570px (W) x 820px (H). Background: White (#FFFFFF), Border: Light Gray (#E0E0E0), Radius: ~8px.
*   **Header Region:** [209, 16] to [777, 165].
    *   **Close Button:** Top-right corner, [748, 28] to [769, 49].
    *   **Icon:** Centered folder icon, [470, 75] to [530, 175].
    *   **Title:** Centered text "Choose a destination path to save the file:", [340, 175] to [660, 200].
    *   **Subtitle:** Centered stats text, [345, 210] to [655, 235].
*   **Tab Bar:** [248, 265] to [740, 305]. Two tabs ("Local", "Cloud") spanning full width of the content area below.
*   **Content List Area:** [248, 310] to [740, 720]. Contains drive rows.
    *   **Row 1 (Windows C):** [258, 335] to [730, 395].
    *   **Row 2 (Temp D):** [258, 415] to [730, 485]. *Selected state.*
    *   **Row 3 (Choose Folder):** [258, 510] to [730, 565].
*   **Footer Region:** [230, 760] to [760, 810].
    *   **Toggle Control (Left):** [245, 775] to [400, 805].
    *   **Save Button (Right):** [635, 770] to [747, 810].

**2) TEXT (VERBATIM)**
*   **Dialog Title:** `Choose a destination path to save the file:` (Center)
*   **Dialog Subtitle:** `You have 1139246 file(s) (146.41 GB) to recover.` (Center)
*   **Tab 1:** `Local` (Center in tab)
*   **Tab 2:** `Cloud` (Center in tab)
*   **Row 1 Label:** `Windows (C:)`
*   **Row 1 Stats:** `31.32 GB/149.45 GB`
*   **Row 2 Label:** `Temporary Storage (D:)`
*   **Row 2 Stats:** `146.07 GB/150 GB`
*   **Row 3 Label:** `Choose folder...`
*   **Footer Toggle Label:** `Enable file repair`
*   **Footer Button:** `Save`

**3) COLOR**
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Dialog BG: `#FFFFFF` (ESTIMATED)
    *   Modal Overlay (behind dialog): `#000000` at ~40% opacity (ESTIMATED)
    *   Selected Row BG: `#E6F0FF` (Light Blue, ESTIMATED)
    *   Tab Active BG: `#FFFFFF` (ESTIMATED)
    *   Tab Inactive BG: `#F5F5F5` (Light Gray, ESTIMATED)
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text (Title/Labels): `#1A1A1A` (Near Black, ESTIMATED)
    *   Secondary Text (Stats/Subtitle): `#666666` (Dark Gray, ESTIMATED)
    *   Warning Text (Red Stats): `#D32F2F` (Red, ESTIMATED - visible on Row 1 space)
*   **Accents & Controls:**
    *   Primary Blue (Button/Toggle/Radio): `#1677FF` (Standard Win11 Blue, ESTIMATED)
    *   Warning Icon (Red): `#FF3B30` (ESTIMATED)
    *   Warning Icon (Yellow): `#FFCC00` (ESTIMATED)

**4) TYPOGRAPHY**
*   **Title:** Sans-Segoe UI, Size ~14px, Weight 600 (Semi-bold).
*   **Subtitle/Stats:** Sans-Segoe UI, Size ~12px, Weight 400 (Regular).
*   **Tab Labels:** Sans-Segoe UI, Size ~13px, Weight 500 (Medium).
*   **Row Labels:** Sans-Segoe UI, Size ~13px, Weight 500.
*   **Button Text:** Sans-Segoe UI, Size ~13px, Weight 600.

**5) SPACING & SIZING**
*   **Dialog Padding:** ~40px left/right, ~30px top/bottom.
*   **Row Height:** ~60px.
*   **Radio Button Size:** 20x20px diameter.
*   **Drive Icon Size:** 32x32px.
*   **Gutter (Icon to Text):** ~12px.
*   **Button Height:** 36px-40px.
*   **Border Radius:** Dialog 8px, Buttons/Tabs 6px, Rows 8px.

**6) CONTROLS & STATES**
*   **Tabs:** Segmented control style. State: "Local" is **Selected** (White bg, connected to content border). "Cloud" is **Normal** (Gray bg).
*   **Radio Buttons:**
    *   Row 1: **Normal** (Empty circle).
    *   Row 2: **Selected** (Filled blue circle with white dot).
    *   Row 3: **Normal** (Empty circle).
*   **Toggle Switch ("Enable file repair"):** State is **ON** (Thumb right, Track blue).
*   **Button ("Save"):** State is **Enabled** (Solid blue background, white text).
*   **Warning Icons:**
    *   Row 1: Red warning triangle (Insufficient space indication).
    *   Row 2: Yellow warning triangle (Low space indication).

**7) ICONOGRAPHY**
*   **Style:** Fluent Design / Windows 11 style (Filled/Semi-filled).
*   **Header Icon:** Blue folder with a document inside.
*   **Drive Icons:**
    *   Windows (C:): Hard Drive icon (Blue/Grey).
    *   Temporary Storage (D:): Hard Drive icon (Grey/Blue).
    *   Choose Folder: Yellow folder icon.
*   **Warning Icons:** Triangle with exclamation mark.

**8) STATE**
*   **Page State:** **Partial / Selection Required**. The user has scanned files and opened the "Recover" or "Save" destination dialog. A default selection ("Temporary Storage (D:)") is pre-selected or user-selected.
*   **Contextual Warnings:**
    *   **Insufficient Space:** The "Windows (C:)" drive shows a red warning icon, indicating the free space (31.32 GB) is less than the recovery size (146.41 GB).
    *   **Low Space:** The "Temporary Storage (D:)" drive shows a yellow warning icon, indicating the free space (146.07 GB) is very close to or slightly less than the required size (146.41 GB), or simply low generally.
*   **Motion:** None observed (static screenshot).
